description: Source code implementing deployment rolling update logic for Kubernetes, including functions for scaling replica sets, cleaning up unhealthy replicas, and managing rolling updates within the deployment controller.

classes.name: DeploymentController
classes.description: Controller managing deployment rollouts and replica set scaling.

methods.name: rolloutRolling
methods.description: Main method to perform a rolling update, scaling up new replica sets and scaling down old ones.

methods.name: reconcileNewReplicaSet
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the new replica set to match deployment specifications.

methods.name: reconcileOldReplicaSets
methods.description: Manages scaling down old replica sets during a deployment update.

methods.name: cleanupUnhealthyReplicas
methods.description: Scales down old replica sets with unhealthy pods to ensure deployment progress.

methods.name: scaleDownOldReplicaSetsForRollingUpdate
methods.description: Scales down old replica sets while maintaining deployment availability constraints.
